author: hpux
body:
Gamemode: Nebula
Map Name: Asteroid Belt
Made by: Charmy Clan Build Team: PeachyYas, Sethskye, 99250, X_Heat, kammy878.
Album(In 99250's POV): http://imgur.com/a/icEqk
Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?9mk886llk29r5ux
YML: Pls
Description:
A space-themed map in which 1 team is labeled "Mars" and one is labeled "Jupiter". The colors are white and black. The middle of the map represents a large asteroid, and the "islands" of the map are asteroids scattered around which contain iron blocks and some with hidden chests. There are also a few comets near the middle. 3 monuments: Left, Right, and Back. Each inside the 3 towers next to spawn. There is also a gold supply underneath spawn.
*Note: This is our 1st Nebula map as a build team, and we're all pretty new to building.
Enjoy!

replies.author: _CubeRoot
replies.body:
Looks too smooth. Add some craters in the metorites and give them some depth! The spawn looks a bit out of place. Make it fit in with the theme and not like a floating box with a satellite on top. A flame and punch bow will be a general pain in the ass, so will the knockback two sword. Nerf em. The fire aspect sword might work, but still seems a little annoying. Are they gold? I can't tell by the picture, but if they are it is a good choice, considering their enchantments. Give the asteroids a bit more colour/variation, too.
Overall, it looks a little hard to navigate, the spawn looks out of place and the asteroids look blank. It doesn't show much hard work. However, it has potential and I like the placements of the items, spawns and monuments. Good work.

EDIT: I also spawned in the void when I downloaded it :c
EDIT #2: Yeah, where's the map at? Download's dead.
